name: smwmusic-mega-man-2-mm2wily1-mml-dr-wily-s-castle-1-2
title: Mega Man 2 - mm2wily1.mml ~ Dr. Wily's Castle 1 & 2 (2008 SMW-Mix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Dr. Wily's Castle 1 & 2 from Mega Man 2 stylized after an old SMW port from 2008 when the @7 steel drum used to be the best sample ever. Seriously, I have a ton of nostalgia for this version, and I remember listening to this exactly after I first heard the song in Mega Man 2 and fell in love with it. I did heavily base this off my previous port / remix of this theme.

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. D Minor (S.S.H Pitch)
3. C Minor (Smash 4 Pitch)
4. D# Minor (Power Fighters Pitch)
5. E Minor (Sonic Mega Mix v4 Pitch)
